name: @kojo/plugin-ui-sugar-editor
description: Sugar editing experience (v0.3 S6): a ui.editor.decorator contribution turning sugar transpile diagnostics into column-precise squiggles, plus a 'sugar verdict' ui.panel showing the compile verdict (compilable / warnings / errors) for the active .kojo file. Presentation/translation only - all semantics live in the kojo-sugar plugin's pure sugar.transpile service.
